newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka stocks close marginally higher.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka stocks close marginally higher.

text.p: Sri Lanka stocks closed marginally higher after moving in a tight range as buyers were held back by a lack of sellers, brokers said.
The all share index closed up 0.37 points at 641.07. Gainers outnumbered losers 20 to 15. Aitken Spence rose 4.50 rupees to 115 and John Keells Holdings 2.75 to 205.
"Investors will not sell because they expect good company profits in 1997," said a trader at brokerage CT Smith.
Thursday's agreement between the government and the main opposition party to take a bipartisan approach to solve the costly ethnic conflict, also kept sellers on the sidelines.
